checks: Object meshes after modifier application; outward normals recalculated; finite coordinates, face area and edge manifold checks. Separate intersecting solids are deliberate assembly pieces, not boolean-unioned.
limitations: No global self-intersection solver or full animation collision sweep was performed.
Zero boundary edges does not prove an assembled part has no collision.
Island decals are intentionally single sided; font caps may have open triangulated boundaries depending on font conversion.
Lighting, metal reflection and transparent glass must also be checked in the Three.js viewer.
